bio_en: Chewu Jixing, also known as Mengdong, was a Qing Buddhist teacher trained in Chan and scriptural study. He later taught at Mount Hongluo and emphasized Buddha recollection and Pure Land practice. Later Pure Land tradition honors him as its twelfth patriarch. His disciples preserved his teachings in the Recorded Sayings of Chan Master Chewu.
bio_summary: 際醒字徹悟，號夢東，晚居紅螺山，力弘念佛。後世尊為蓮宗十二祖，法語由門人集為《徹悟禪師語錄》。
name: 際醒
